correctness.rationale: For k>=2 the source threshold tau_c(k)=min_{a>0}[2+(2a^k+1)/(a+...+a^(k-1))] has a unique minimizer by its one-sign-change derivative polynomial. Reciprocal comparison puts it below 1, and comparison with a=1 plus a^-1-1 lower bound yields 0< c_k=-k log a_k<=3k/(k-1)<=6. Rescaling gives F_k(c)=k(tau(c)-2)=F(c)+G(c)/k+O(k^-2) uniformly with a derivative on the compact domain. F(c)=c(e^c+2)/(e^c-1) has unique positive nondegenerate minimizer c* solving e^c+1-2e^-c=3c. Thus c_k=c*+O(k^-1) and tau_c(k)=2+C*/k+D*/k^2+O(k^-3), with C*=F(c*) and D*=c*^2(1+2e^-c*)(1+e^-c*)/[2(1-e^-c*)^2]. Expanding 2cosh beta recovers beta_c=sqrt(C*) k^-1/2+(D*-C*^2/12)/(2sqrt(C*)) k^-3/2+O(k^-5/2). Independent 55-digit root/minimum computations recovered c*=1.035658479401893..., C*=2.745643576732724..., D*=2.986777725427654..., and k=20,100,1000 values; finite checks only supplement rigorous uniform expansion.
